summary: Iteration 15 review — RouterOS live traffic + SNMP historical graphs + Routing menus + custom overview cards + public display carousel + Vendor CPU/SNMP diagnose. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15.py = 39/39 PASS. Playwright verified: clicking Lab SNMP Agent lands on 'Interface Graphs' + 'Manage SNMP' toggle; clicking IDC MONITORING lands on 'Interface Graphs' + 'Manage (RouterOS)' toggle that swaps to Interfaces tab + Graphs button returns; 11/11 Routing menu items rendered (Routes, Routing Tables, VRF, OSPF Instances/Areas/Interfaces/Neighbors, BGP Connections/Sessions, Routing Filters, BFD) — Routing Tables opens against the real router without error; Traffic tab renders new traffic-iface picker; Customise modal shows all three card types + Live/1 day/2 days/1 week/Last month timeframes; Overview already renders a persisted iface-traffic card ('Lab uplink') with value readout '↓ x / ↑ y Mbps'; public /display/{token} with carousel=true renders display-rotator with dots for traffic/alarms/topology/devices + display-rotate-toggle; clicking a dot flips the toggle text to 'resume rotation'. Backend covered: recorded registry auto-scan no duplicates (double scan, len==len(set)); manual empty → 422; manual unknown iface → 422; duplicate names de-duplicated; selection persists after reload; /devices/{id}/snmp/diagnose returns host/port/from_ip/ping/configured/answering/detail/hint — Lab answering=true, IDC MONITORING answering=false with remediation hint; /devices/{id}/interface-history shape (iface, hours, bucket_seconds, retention_days=30, samples, traffic, ping, peak, average) and hours clamped to 720 when requesting 10000; iface_metrics TTL index = 30 days; POST /api/dashboards accepts cards array with device-count/iface-traffic/device-ping; iface-traffic without device_id or without iface → 422; PUT + DELETE work; 11 routing endpoints allow-listed on MikroTik (200 items array from real router) and 400 on non-MikroTik Lab; PUT /api/workspaces/ws-default/public-display accepts carousel+carousel_seconds, public payload includes display.carousel/carousel_seconds; carousel_seconds=1 → 422 (must be 5..300); no credentials leaked in public payload; monitor/status still reports retention_days=30 and both devices; cron/monitor-scan with no token still 401.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a display-dot pauses rotation (setPaused(true)) but does NOT pin only that panel; because `carousel = data?.display?.carousel && !paused`, when paused=true `carousel` becomes false so ALL panels (traffic + alarms + topology + devices) render at once — same layout as carousel disabled. Spec says clicking a dot should PIN that panel. Fix: when a dot is pinned, keep single-panel mode using the selected slide (e.g. render `!carousel || i === slide` and only hide the others when in carousel mode OR when a pin flag is set).

action_items: (LOW) DisplayBoard: clicking a dot should render only the pinned panel instead of pausing (which currently reveals all panels). Introduce a pinned-slide state independent of carousel/paused so `shown(panel)` returns true only for the pinned index.
critical_code_review_comments: monitor.py sync_registry only appends new interfaces to snmp_watch_interfaces; it never prunes stale names. If an interface is removed on the device, it stays in `recorded` forever. Consider optional cleanup (e.g. drop names not seen for N sweeps) — but not urgent.

monitor.py cpu_load: iterates hrProcessorLoad + vendor OIDs; on failure it silently returns 0 which is exactly what the spec wants (no crash). Verified via SnmpPanel — CPU tile shows '—' when cpu is 0/missing (jsx: `snmp.cpu ? \`${snmp.cpu}%\` : '—'`). ✓ The iter14 cosmetic issue is fixed.

boards.py CARD_HOURS: (0,24,48,168,720) — the endpoint clamps unknown hours to 24 (`card.hours if card.hours in CARD_HOURS else 24`) but doesn't reject them explicitly. Not a bug, just silent normalisation; the UI never sends invalid values.
boards.py clean_cards: device-ping requires device_id but doesn't require iface — correct. iface-traffic requires both — correct.

InterfaceGraphs.jsx iface state initialisation: `setIface(prev => prev || recorded[0] || "")` — good, respects existing selection. Iface label rendered from state directly so the earlier iter11-13 bug of stale label is fixed by construction.

InterfaceGraphs.jsx live mode: for non-MikroTik vendors, live sampling calls POST /devices/{id}/snmp/scan every 15s. That triggers a real SNMP walk against the box each tick — for a device with many boards visiting the graph tab, this is heavy. Acceptable for the current tenant size but flag for future rate-limiting.

DisplayBoard.jsx: `shown(panel)` uses `!carousel || visible[slide % visible.length] === panel`. When carousel is enabled AND paused, `carousel` local becomes false → `shown()` returns true for everything. See UI bug above.
display.py: DisplayIn.carousel_seconds bounded 5..300 (Pydantic ge/le). Verified 422 on 1.

server.py routing resource paths correct: `/routing/table`, `/ip/vrf`, `/routing/ospf/instance`, etc. WRITE_COMMANDS defined for editable ones; ospf-neighbors, bgp-sessions and routing-bfd correctly read-only (no add/set/remove).

monitor.py interface_history clamp: `hours = max(1, min(hours, RETENTION_DAYS * 24))` — hours=0 (live) is elevated to 1 here, but the live-mode branch runs only in the frontend so the backend endpoint isn't hit with hours=0.

TrafficPanel row-focus + iface picker were not exercised end-to-end because the real MikroTik responds slowly; the traffic-iface DOM element is present. Backend Traffic endpoint is unchanged from iter14.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional regressions. All 12 feature bullets from the request are satisfied. Only follow-up: DisplayBoard dot-click currently PAUSES rotation and reveals all panels instead of PINNING one panel. Fix: introduce a `pinned` state (index) separate from `paused`, and gate `shown(panel)` on `pinned!=null ? visible[pinned]===panel : (!carousel || visible[slide]===panel)`.
